Finding a solid USB condenser microphone under ₹2,000 for gaming and streaming is all about picking a model with a **cardioid polar pattern** (rejects background noise/keyboard clicks) and a dedicated gain knob or quick-mute button. 

---

### **Top Microphones Under ₹2,000 in India**

| Model | Price (Approx.) | Key Features | Stand/Mount Included | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Maono AU-PM461TR** | ₹1,699 – ₹1,899 | Cardioid pattern, gain control knob, 192kHz/24-bit sampling, USB plug & play | Desktop Tripod | **Overall Audio Quality & Voice Clarity** |
| **CLAW Studio One / Ant Esports Streamer** | ₹1,299 – ₹1,599 | Cardioid USB condenser, volume control, mute button, lightweight design | Adjustable Stand | **Budget Value & Simple Discord Comm-setup** |
| **Audio Array AA-02 / AA-06** | ₹1,499 – ₹1,899 | Metallic build, built-in noise filter, gain adjustment, RGB models available | Heavy Base Tripod | **Durable Build & Clean Setup Looks** |
| **FIFINE K669B** *(Wait for Sale)* | ₹2,100 – ₹2,399 | All-metal body, gain knob, rich full sound | Tripod Stand | **Entry-Level Gold Standard** *(If budget stretches ₹200-₹300)* |

---

### **Key Buying Tips for Streaming**
* **Focus on Cardioid Pattern:** Mics with a cardioid pattern pick up sound directly in front of them and block noise coming from behind the mic (like mechanical keyboard clicks or PC fan noise).
* **Avoid Clip-on Lavalier Mics for PC Streaming:** Lavalier (collar) mics capture too much room echo and ambient noise compared to desk USB condenser mics.
* **Add Krisp or OBS Noise Suppression:** Under ₹2,000, condenser mics are sensitive. Pair your mic with free software noise suppression like **OBS RNNoise** or **NVIDIA Broadcast** to make your stream sound like a pro setup.

If you can stretch your budget by ₹200–₹300, the **FIFINE K669B** is the undisputed king for sound quality. Otherwise, the **Maono AU-PM461TR** offers the most natural voice capture under the ₹2,000 mark.
